notes.title: DLC: Throne of Rebirth has been released!
notes.content:
DLC: Throne of Rebirth has been released! In which most of the content consists of exquisite illustrations without text, along with a character dossier that is primarily text-based, without any playable content. Welcome to use the content to create derivative works for this game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2971490/DLC/

notes.title: 同世界观下的关联游戏
notes.content: 如果对《光明王传说》的世界观感兴趣，可以尝试一下相同作者制作的游戏《堕天者～Back to Origin～》，在steam上可以搜索到，商店链接（完全免费）：https://store.steampowered.com/app/1836970/_Back_to_Origin/
